{{Top|leg}}
A '''holostatue''' was a decorative hologram that remained active and stationary, similar to a physical statue. Holostatues of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] companions were placed in the [[Leisure Garden]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Axial Park]] district.
